viewing_check: Estimate $15-30, current bid $5 (+22% BP). At the viewing: (1) Read the 5 blank or worn spines: plain blue, pink, dark navy with red ribbon, the black item behind Tahiti and the black item lying flat at the front. (2) Identify the Lord Fisher book and look for any signature or inscription. (3) Robey: check for 1920 Grant Richards on the title page and any inscription. (4) Check whether Beautiful Scotland has its jacket. If nothing turns up, bid no more than about A$30-40 all-in.
